dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。宜しくお願いします。はじめに年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a counselor here. It's nice to meet you. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 17才　男です
dialogue.English: I'm 17 years old, male.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。それでは本日はどのようなご相談でおこしいただきましたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So, what brings you in for a consultation today?

dialogue.content: 相談ということでもないんですけれど、それでもいいですか
dialogue.English: It’s not exactly a consultation, but would that still be okay?

dialogue.content: はい、どんなことでも結構ですよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, of course. You can talk about anything at all.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 安心しました
dialogue.English: That's a relief.

dialogue.content: 今高２なんですけど、
dialogue.English: I'm in my second year of high school right now,

dialogue.content: そろそろ志望校を決めないといけなくて
dialogue.English: and I need to decide on my preferred schools soon,

dialogue.content: でも、特にしたい勉強もないっていうか
dialogue.English: but it's like, there's nothing I particularly want to study.

dialogue.content: でも、まだ働くより学生でいたいし
dialogue.English: But I'd rather stay a student than start working yet.

dialogue.content: 先のことを考えるともやるんです
dialogue.English: and when I think about the future, I feel gloomy.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうでしたか、、
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how you're feeling...

dialogue.content: それはいつ頃から思うようになりましたか？
dialogue.English: When did you start to feel that way?

dialogue.content: 去年くらいから
dialogue.English: Since about last year.

dialogue.content: 去年なんかきっかけになったことがありましたか？
dialogue.English: Did something happen last year that might have triggered it?

dialogue.content: 先のことを考えても
dialogue.English: Even when I think about the future...

dialogue.content: きっかけですか？
dialogue.English: A trigger?

dialogue.content: 特に…でも、進路指導とかあるので、学校で聞かれるからかな
dialogue.English: Not really... but we have career guidance, and they ask us about it at school, so maybe that’s why.

dialogue.content: そうっだったんですね。進路活動が始まって考えるようになったからという事ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you started thinking about it because the school's career guidance activities began.

dialogue.content: 多分
dialogue.English: Probably.

dialogue.content: そうかと
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: ちなみにお友達とは進路の件でお話しされましたか？
dialogue.English: By the way, have you talked about career paths with your friends?

dialogue.content: はい　普通に話しませ
dialogue.English: Yes, we talk about it normally.

dialogue.content: す
でも　みんな本当のことは言わないだろうし
dialogue.English: But I doubt anyone says what they really think,

dialogue.content: 自分もそうです
dialogue.English: and I'm the same way.

dialogue.content: うんうんお友達の方は進路についてはどのように話されていましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. What do your friends say about their career paths?

dialogue.content: まわりの、やつは
dialogue.English: The people around me,

dialogue.content: みんな、この学校に行きたいとか、こういう仕事がいいとかあって
dialogue.English: they all have schools they want to go to, or jobs they think would be good,

dialogue.content: それに合わせてなんとなく学校も選んでいるみたいです
dialogue.English: and it seems like they're choosing their schools based on that, more or less.

dialogue.content: 先のことを考えてもなんにも浮かばないし
dialogue.English: But when I think about the future, nothing comes to mind.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。みんな本当のことは言わないだろうけどこの学校に行きたいという答えがあったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So even though you think they might not be saying what they truly feel, they still have an answer like, 'I want to go to this school.'

dialogue.content: 考えていると何のために生きてるかも分からなくなってきて、全てがつらなく感じるというけ
dialogue.English: When I think about it, I start to wonder what I'm even living for, and everything feels meaningless.

dialogue.content: そのように感じられているのですね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you've been feeling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 去年から進路活動が始まって進路について考えるようになって、まだやりたい勉強も思いつかず、まだ働きたくない
dialogue.English: Since last year, when career planning started, you've been thinking about your future, but you haven't found anything you want to study, and you don't want to start working yet.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お友達は本当の事かはわからないけどこの学校に行きたいと言っていて
dialogue.English: And your friends, although you're not sure if they're being truthful, are saying they want to go to certain schools.

dialogue.content: それは少し不安になってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That must make you feel a little anxious, right?

dialogue.content: 不安…なのかな…
dialogue.English: Anxious... I wonder if that's it...

dialogue.content: 不安というよりは
dialogue.English: It's less about being anxious,

dialogue.content: うんうん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm,

dialogue.content: 全部めんどくさくなってくる感じです
dialogue.English: it's more like everything just starts to feel like a hassle.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、失礼しました。
dialogue.English: I see—my apologies.

dialogue.content: もう進路を考えることがめんどくさくなっていしまうという事ですね。
dialogue.English: So thinking about your path itself has started to feel like a hassle.

dialogue.content: ちがいます
dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

dialogue.content: 全部がって言いましたよね
dialogue.English: I said *everything*, didn't I?

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、失礼しました。
dialogue.English: You're right, I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 何のために生きているのか分からなくなってすべてがめんどくさくなるんですね。
dialogue.English: You start to wonder what you're living for, and then everything becomes a hassle.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、ちなみにそのことは他にはなされたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see... By the way, have you spoken to anyone else about this?

dialogue.content: ないです
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: 親には言いづらいし、兄も分かってくれなさそうなので
dialogue.English: It's hard to talk to my parents, and I don't think my older brother would understand.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。今は一人でこのお気持ちを持っていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So right now, you're holding these feelings all by yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なので、ここのことをネットで見つけて
dialogue.English: That's why I found this place online,

dialogue.content: 来ました
dialogue.English: and came here.

dialogue.content: ご家族以外では話せそうだなという方はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Besides your family, is there anyone you feel you could talk to?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、来ていただいて話していただいてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for coming and sharing with me.

dialogue.content: 時々、おばあちゃんとおしゃべりすることはあるんですけど、勉強とか仕事のこととか、さすがにおばあちゃんは分からないし
dialogue.English: I sometimes chat with my grandmother, but when it comes to studying or work, she wouldn’t really understand.

dialogue.content: うんうんそうでしたか、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんとはどんなお話をしたりするのですか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things do you talk about with your grandmother?

dialogue.content: 別にふつうです
dialogue.English: Nothing special, just normal stuff.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんが元気か聞いたり
dialogue.English: Like, I'll ask if she's doing well,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: ごはん何食べたの、とか
dialogue.English: or what she ate,

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんは隣の家だけど、１人ぐらしなので、
dialogue.English: My grandmother lives next door, but she lives alone, so...

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。おばあちゃんと話すときはどんなお気持ちですか？
dialogue.English: I see. How do you feel when you talk with your grandmother?

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんとですか？
dialogue.English: With my grandma?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんはずっと自分に優しくしてくれるので疲れたときとかおばあちゃんよところにいるとほっとする感じです
dialogue.English: She's always been kind to me, so when I'm tired, being at her place feels comforting.

dialogue.content: 母は兄が大好きで自慢なので、おばあちゃんはこっそり自分だけおこづかいくれたりします
dialogue.English: My mother adores my older brother and is proud of him, so my grandma secretly gives me pocket money.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんを気遣ってお話しされているのですね。おばあちゃんは優しいお孫さんがいてきっと嬉しいく思っていられますね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're very considerate when you talk to your grandmother. She must be very happy to have such a kind grandson.

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったんですね！
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happens!

dialogue.content: さい
はい、です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 自分も早く年をとって
dialogue.English: I also want to grow old soon

dialogue.content: 自分だけにこっそりお小遣いを上げてくれるんですね
dialogue.English: So she secretly gives pocket money just to you.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんみたいにのんびり暮らしたいです
dialogue.English: and live a relaxed life like my grandma.

dialogue.content: あ～それはいいですね！
dialogue.English: Ah, that sounds wonderful!

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんはセンスがよくて、絵とかも画くし
dialogue.English: My grandma has good taste; she paints pictures and things,

dialogue.content: ピアノも弾くし
dialogue.English: and she plays the piano.

dialogue.content: 結構格好いいんです
dialogue.English: She's actually pretty cool.

dialogue.content: お優しいあなたはきっとおばあちゃんみたいに優しく話しているとほっとするような感じになれますね。
dialogue.English: You are such a kind person; I'm sure you can become someone like your grandmother, a person who others find comforting to talk to.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんのところのおやつは近くで売ってないようなものばっかりで
dialogue.English: The snacks at my grandma's place are always things you can't buy around here.

dialogue.content: それはいきたくなりますね！
dialogue.English: That would make anyone want to visit!

dialogue.content: すごくおばあちゃんのことがお好きなんですね。
dialogue.English: You really love your grandmother, don't you.

dialogue.content: 帰ってきたらおばあちゃんのところに寄っておやつを食べてから家に帰ります
dialogue.English: When I get home from school, I stop by her place for a snack before going to my own house.

dialogue.content: はい、優しいおばあちゃんです
dialogue.English: Yes, she's a very kind grandmother.

dialogue.content: どうでしょう、あばあちゃんに仕事の事や学校のことはわからないけど今のお気持ちを話されてみるというのは
dialogue.English: What do you think about trying to talk to your grandmother about your current feelings, even if she doesn't understand about jobs or school?

dialogue.content: うーん、おばあちゃんに話してもわからないと思うんですよ
dialogue.English: Hmm, even if I talk to her, I don’t think she would understand.

dialogue.content: 心配するかもしれないし
dialogue.English: And she might worry.

dialogue.content: 仕事や学校のことはわからなくても小さなころからあなたを見ているおばあちゃんにはあなたの今のお気持ちはわかってくれると思います
dialogue.English: She may not understand about work or school, but as someone who has watched over you since you were little, I think your grandmother would understand how you're feeling right now.

dialogue.content: そうかな
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: おばあちゃん、分からない話で困らないかな
dialogue.English: I wonder if she'd be troubled by a topic she doesn't understand.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんも大好きなあなただから力になってくれると思いましたが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I thought that because she loves you so much, she would want to be a source of strength for you. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そんなお気持ちもあるのですね。
dialogue.English: So you have those concerns as well.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 兄は良い学校に受かったので、自分のことを心配しています
dialogue.English: My brother got into a good school, so she's worried about me.

dialogue.content: 昔から兄は勉強も運動もよくできるので
dialogue.English: My brother has always been good at both academics and sports.

dialogue.content: 母の自慢です
dialogue.English: He's my mother's pride and joy.

dialogue.content: だから、母が自分のことも気にするように、おばあちゃんが気をつかってくれているのがなんかかなしい気持ちになります
dialogue.English: That's why it feels kind of sad when my grandma shows me extra consideration, as if she's trying to make up for my mom's focus on my brother.

dialogue.content: では、先ほどおっしゃっていたおばあちゃんの絵やピアノをすこし習ってみるのも何かのきっかけにもなるかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Well then, perhaps trying to learn a little of your grandmother's painting or piano, which you mentioned earlier, could be a good starting point for something.

dialogue.content: 自分がですか？
dialogue.English: Me?

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんの発表会は行くけど
dialogue.English: I go to her recitals,

dialogue.content: 自分はあまり興味がないかな…
dialogue.English: but I'm not really interested in it for myself...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、悲しいという事も思ったりするんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you also feel sad about that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。発表会見に行くんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you go to her recitals.

dialogue.content: 行きますよ
dialogue.English: Of course I go.

dialogue.content: 自分が行かないと、家族は誰も行かないから
dialogue.English: If I don't go, no one else in the family will.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんはあなたが学校や仕事の事は話さなくて状況がわからないから心配されている感じもしましたが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I got the sense that perhaps your grandmother is worried because you don't talk about school or your future, so she doesn't know what your situation is. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: 話さなくて心配になることもあるんですね
dialogue.English: So not talking can make someone worry, too.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんには心配かけたくないので、ちょっと話してみます
dialogue.English: I don't want to make my grandmother worry, so I'll try talking to her a little.

dialogue.content: 状況が全く分からなかったら心配になると思います。
dialogue.English: I think anyone would worry if they had no idea what was going on.

dialogue.content: はい　わかりました
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんのためになるならそうしてみます
dialogue.English: If it will be for my grandmother's sake, I'll do it.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんに今こんなこと考えていて気持ちということを話してみるのもおばあちゃんもうれしいのかなと思えました。
dialogue.English: I was thinking that your grandmother might be happy if you tried telling her what you're thinking and feeling right now.

dialogue.content: そうですね。おばあちゃんのためにって本当にあなたは優しい方ですね。
dialogue.English: Yes. To do it for your grandmother's sake... you truly are a kind person.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 優しくて人に思いやりがあるあなたを私も応援しています！！
dialogue.English: I'll be cheering for you, someone who is so kind and considerate of others!!

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: ぜひ、おばあちゃんに話した後でもいつでも相談に来てください。お持ちしています。
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come back for a consultation anytime, even after you've spoken with your grandmother. I'll be waiting for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: では本日は失礼します。
dialogue.English: Well then, that's all for today.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much for today.)

dialogue.content: 大切なお話ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your important story with me.
